==English==

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:lbor|la:lēgālis<t:legal>|tree=1}}
{{lbor|en|la|lēgālis||legal}}, from {{m|la|lēx||law}}. {{doublet|en|loyal|leal}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈliː.ɡəl/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈli.ɡəl/|a=US}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-legal.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|iːɡəl|s=2}}
* {{hyph|en|le|gal}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj}}

# Relating to the [[law]] or to [[lawyer]]s.
#: {{cot|en|equitable}}
#: {{ux|en|'''legal''' profession}}
#* {{RQ:Economist|date=2013-06-08|volume=407|issue=8839|page=55
|url=http://www.economist.com/news/business/21579011-president-proposes-new-round-intellectual-property-reform-obama-goes-troll-hunting|title=Obama goes troll-hunting
|passage=According to this saga of intellectual-property misanthropy, these creatures [patent trolls] roam the business world, buying up patents and then using them to demand extravagant payouts from companies they accuse of infringing them. Often, their victims pay up rather than face the costs of a '''legal''' battle.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200919102154/https://www.economist.com/business/2013/06/08/obama-goes-troll-hunting}}
# Having its [[basis]] in the law.<!--It's not quite clear what this means. "Within the confines of law" is the sense below; "pertaining to law" is the one above. Quotations, examples?-->
#: {{ux|en|'''legal''' precedent}}
# Being [[establish]]ed, [[permit]]ted, [[require]]d or [[prescribe]]d by law.
#: {{syn|en|lawful|legitimate|licit|Thesaurus:lawful}}
#: {{ant|en|banned|contraband|disallowed|forbidden|illegal|outlawed|unlawful|;|black-market|back-alley}}
#: {{ux|en|'''legal''' motion}}
#* {{RQ:LATimes|date=17 December 1992|author=Michael Granberry|title=Vanishing Act: Animals: A world without the homely rhino?{{nb...|It’s possible, say the endangered creature’s friends, who are drumming up support for preservation and anti-poaching efforts.}}|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20250720093338/https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1992-12-17-vw-2862-story.html|passage=In South Africa, it’s still '''legal''' to “trophy hunt” the white rhino, which [[w:Anna Merz|{{quote-gloss|Anna}} Merz]] and others find reprehensible.}}
#* {{RQ:Economist|date=2013-08-23|volume=408|issue=8850
|url=http://www.economist.com/news/briefing/21584003-his-i-have-dream-speech-martin-luther-king-threw-out-challenge-america-how-has-it|title=Waking life
|passage=After 50 years, '''legal''' segregation is a distant memory, and race in America is not the unbridgeable chasm it once was. The country has a black president. The sort of comity that King evoked, in which the descendants of slaves and of slave owners “sit down together at the table of brotherhood”, can be found in many places, including the Deep South. The rate of marriage between blacks and whites is rising.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20191113105049/https://www.economist.com/news/briefing/21584003-his-i-have-dream-speech-martin-luther-king-threw-out-challenge-america-how-has-it|archivedate=13 November 2019}}
# Following the [[rule]]s or syntax of a [[system]], such as a [[game]] or a programming language.
#: {{ux|en|If you have no '''legal''' move, but are not in [[check]] the game is a draw.}}
# {{lb|en|slang|,|sometimes|offensive}} Above the [[age of consent]] or the legal [[drinking age]].
#: {{ant|en|underage}}
#* {{quote-book|en|date=2012-09-18|author=Sandra Brown|title=Low Pressure|publisher=Grand Central Publishing|isbn=9781455501533
|text="Is she even '''legal'''? Shame on you, diddlin' a girl too young to buy beer. You being a church deacon and all." If looks could kill, Dale would be dead.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|date=2024-04-18|author=Ayin Quijano|title=Bottoms Up, Boracay (Season 2 Amihan)|publisher=Ayin Quijano
|text="Is she even '''legal'''? She looks like a minor." Elias whispers back, "Of course. I checked her passport. She's 20. What do you take me for? Be nice. I like her." I immediately smile at the girl behind Elias,{{nb...}}}}
# {{lb|en|colloquial|,|chiefly|US}} Permitting the use and/or sale of [[cannabis]]; in which cannabis is lawful.
#* {{quote-book|en|date=2016-01-30|author=Jasper Stohner|title=101 Money Making Methods in the Marijuana Madness Movement of 2016|publisher=Lulu.com|isbn=9781329866157|page=45
|text=Whether you're interested in opening a retail marijuana store in a '''legal''' state or if you're interested in investing in someone or a company, which is operating in a '''legal''' state, there are{{nb...}}}}
#* {{quote-book|en|date=2019-09-13|author=Tracy Ferrell|title=Migrating for Medical Marijuana: Pioneers in a New Frontier of Treatment|publisher=McFarland|isbn=9781476678597|page=160
|text=[Because] marijuana is still a federally illegal drug, using the drug in a child's presence, even in a '''legal''' state, could thus be construed as child abuse.}}
# {{lb|en|law}} relating to formally codified law, as opposed to [[equity]].
#: {{ant|en|equitable}}
